extension.summary: Server-side search and rating bridge for the Mistuary skin
Mistuary 皮肤的服务端搜索与评分桥
extension.description: Optional add-on. Search uses the Emby server, so Chinese, pinyin, aliases and cast names work the same way as in the Emby app. Without it the skin falls back to its own local search. Nothing is written to your library or settings.
可选插件。搜索走 Emby 服务端，中文、全拼、别名和演员名与 Emby 官方 App 一致；不装时皮肤回退到自带的本地搜索。不改媒体库、不改皮肤设置。
extension.disclaimer: 只在本地读取 Emby 插件的服务器配置，令牌不会写入日志或缓存。
